# Eurovision Games

> Free browser-based multiplayer party game for the Eurovision Song Contest. Predictions, trivia duels, live scoring, no signup, no install.

Eurovision Games at https://eurovision.games is a watch-party companion: hosts create a room (60s), friends join with a code, everyone predicts Top 5 and Worst 5 of Eurovision 2026, plays head-to-head trivia duels during ad breaks, and competes for five trophy titles (Champion, Thief, Duelist, Oracle, Guru). Available in English (/en/) and Greek (/el/).

## Important clarification

Eurovision Games is an unofficial fan-made party game. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by the European Broadcasting Union or the Eurovision Song Contest.

## Core pages
- [home](https://eurovision.games/en): Free browser-based party game for the Eurovision Song Contest. Predictions, trivia duels, live scoring.
- [eurovision-2026](https://eurovision.games/en/eurovision-2026): Eurovision 2026 hub: schedule, semifinals, songs, predictions. Vienna, 16 May 2026.
- [eurovision-night](https://eurovision.games/en/eurovision-night): Complete guide to hosting Eurovision night: 10-step playbook, food, drinks, run-of-show.
- [eurovision-party](https://eurovision.games/en/eurovision-party): Hosting playbook for a Eurovision party: guests, theme, decor, food, run-of-show.
- [eurovision-games](https://eurovision.games/en/eurovision-games): Free interactive party games to play during Eurovision: predictions, trivia, live scoring.
- [how-to-play](https://eurovision.games/en/how-to-play): How to play Eurovision Games — 60-second setup, 6 steps from create-room to trophy reveal.

## Eurovision 2026
- [eurovision-2026-schedule](https://eurovision.games/en/eurovision-2026-schedule): Eurovision 2026 schedule: semifinal 1 (12 May), semifinal 2 (14 May), grand final (16 May), local broadcast times.
- [eurovision-2026-semifinals](https://eurovision.games/en/eurovision-2026-semifinals): Eurovision 2026 semifinals: running order, qualifiers, dates, predictions.
- [eurovision-2026-songs](https://eurovision.games/en/eurovision-2026-songs): All Eurovision 2026 entries by country: songs, artists, lyrics, betting odds.
- [eurovision-2026-predictions](https://eurovision.games/en/eurovision-2026-predictions): Top 5 / Worst 5 predictions for Eurovision 2026, weekly-refreshed odds and country breakdowns.
- [eurovision-trivia](https://eurovision.games/en/eurovision-trivia): 50+ Eurovision trivia questions with answers, plus how to run trivia duels live.
- [eurovision-quiz](https://eurovision.games/en/eurovision-quiz): Take a free Eurovision quiz — choose category and difficulty.
- [eurovision-history](https://eurovision.games/en/eurovision-history): Eurovision history: founding (1956), winners by country, scoring system evolution, key moments.
- [winners](https://eurovision.games/en/winners): Every Eurovision winner from 1956 to today — songs, artists, points, voting breakdown.
- [countries](https://eurovision.games/en/countries): Every country in Eurovision: full entry history, best results, best songs.
